LESSON: RESPONSIBLE PARENTHOOD

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living Today
Topic 5.2: Responsible parenthood
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Responsible parenthood, part of Christian Living Today in Grade 9 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How is responsible parenting achieved?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. use relevant textbooks or internet sources to search for the meaning of responsible parenthood and share findings in class,

2. in turns read, Exodus 20:12, Deuteronomy 11:18-21, Psalms 103:13, Proverbs 15:20, Proverbs 22:6, and Colossians 3:21, discuss and write lessons learnt on a chart or use PowerPoint slides for presentation in class,

3. discuss the causes of irresponsible parenthood today,

4. brainstorm on ways of avoiding unplanned families,

5. conduct a buzz session on moral values needed to avoid unplanned families today ,

6. come up with a play or drama on good parenting,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. use relevant textbooks or internet sources to search for the meaning of responsible parenthood and share findings in class,
2. in turns read, Exodus 20:12, Deuteronomy 11:18-21, Psalms 103:13, Proverbs 15:20, Proverbs 22:6, and Colossians 3:21, discuss and write lessons learnt on a chart or use PowerPoint slides for presentation in class,
3. discuss the causes of irresponsible parenthood today,
4. brainstorm on ways of avoiding unplanned families,
5. conduct a buzz session on moral values needed to avoid unplanned families today ,
6. come up with a play or drama on good parenting,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Responsible parenthood together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: the skill of teamwork is enhanced as learners collegially work in groups, discuss,

brainstorm and express their views confidently.

● Digital Literacy: the skill of identifying and using digital platforms for learning is portrayed as learners search the internet to

get information on different concepts.

● Creativity and imagination: the skill of creativity is exhibited as learners come up with scenarios on good parenting through

dramatisation and role-play.
